observed.engineRpm: Algebraically tied to mean rear wheel angular speed times current total gear ratio, with idle floor.

inputs: re-engagement rate; throttle remains its existing independent gene
states: finite clutch torque capacity and engagement
invariants: No arbitrary torque multiplier or yaw/pose injection.
Crank torque remains within stock torque curve; transient axle torque can only come from modeled rotational energy and current engine work.
AT/DCT/EV cannot acquire a manual clutch-pedal action.
Do not use unverified inertia/capacity values as manufacturer specifications.
validation: Engine can change RPM while disengaged without direct wheel torque.
Re-engagement obeys torque capacity and energy accounting; stored flywheel energy can affect wheel slip.
Overrev/gear engagement/launch/shift behavior must be checked independently.
Recompute/validate prepared records if integrated dynamics change, then repeat paired line-search comparisons.

scorerAudit.scope: No physical vehicle evaluation; same 20 m/s kinematic trace, production Accumulator, unchanged score rules.

sameSignNeutralDrop.description: A 0.04 s / 0.8 m dip to 9.9 degrees breaks the same-sign chain; this is a classifier check, not evidence that grace should apply to all interruptions.

metadataOnlyTransitionComparison.description: Identical +30 to -30 degree transition over 6 m / 0.3 s. Only the road link destination sign changes.

modelAudit.scope: Read-only production model audit. No external claim of real-car capability/specification accuracy. No source or stock parameters changed.

userRequired: Stock RWD specification fixed; no tuning to manufacture success.
Prepared vehicle/course grip genome remains sole starting source.
Both front tire contact points must remain on road; rear departure can be allowed.
Offtrack/collision invalidates whole run; completion required for confirmed score.
Spin/drift break resets multiplier, preserves already-earned points; short direction transition holds multiplier only.
Whole course earns points; markedZONE addsx2; representative is highest valid displayed total.
Broad continuous high-angle drifting with maintained speed; connection across corners and straights.
Short intended direction changes hold the multiplier; user wording does not restrict this to opposite-direction geometric corners.

modelChosen.item: Angle10..70deg; spin75deg at>=3m/s; minimum scoring speed8m/s
Multiplier max2 after60angle/speed-weighted metres, not60road metres
Scoring retention>70%; full connection retention>=90%; prepared reference floor80%
Direction bridge<=0.35s AND<=min(8m,25%straight); beta rate<=4rad/s; only opposite-direction corners
Actual speed reference only resets at later corner after>=0.5s and8m grip recovery
Same steering limits/controller coefficients, quasi-static load/tire approximations, assumed differential for unverified variants
All-region, valid-parent search niches,25%connection proposal share,15%coverage eligibility and progress weights

preserveIntegrity: Do not lower completion thresholds or widen boundaries merely to report success.
Do not use synthetic replay completion as proof of physical stock-vehicle feasibility.
Keep failed genomes out of inheritance; diagnose their prefixes only.
Retain score-only representative semantics while reviewing search-objective alignment.

objectiveReview.fact: Current whole-course score and legacy corner/link completion are separate objectives; >=70% retention earns while >=90% completes.
objectiveReview.implication: High displayed score can come from long/large-angle fragments with0completed regions. Report both and guide mutations by actual missing conditions, without hidden representative veto.

objectiveReview.fact: Continuous drift carries sustained actual speed peak; reference reset requires grip recovery that breaks continuity.
objectiveReview.implication: A tighter later corner may need slower arrival. Test reducing the earlier entry speed through actual genome controls and planning whole sequence, rather than weakening scoring retention.

objectiveReview.fact: Partial coverage takes reason precedence over speedLimited; current connect speed mode is chosen for reason speed, not most partial+slow targets.
objectiveReview.implication: Need diagnose counts and paired evidence-driven angle-plus-speed proposals. Existing adaptive/repair speed changes still exist; it is not a total absence of speed search.

objectiveReview.fact: Connection analysis keeps bestArc while region complete can come from another episode; complete boolean remains scorer-authoritative.
objectiveReview.implication: Keep completed specialists; do not reinterpret unknown or partial evidence as complete.

objectiveReview.fact: Current transition grace is metadata-gated to opposite-sign detected corners, and same-direction links forbid low-angle recovery. A same-direction connecting straight can geometrically admit a deliberate left/right transfer without that metadata.
objectiveReview.implication: This is a behavior-alignment review candidate, not score inflation. Any proposed generalization should require actual short sign crossing, forward progress, speed, time/distance/rate bounds and prevent repeated-position farming. Same-direction manji may need two genuine transfers to return to the following corner direction; a single fixed per-link allowance can still disagree with intended behavior.
objectiveReview.evidence: output/drift-qa/all-vehicle-study/scorer-audit.json (root-produced seven-assertion kinematic score audit; not physical feasibility evidence).

minimumEvidence.reason: ConnectionAnalysis speed evidence has a different speed from the reported regional minimum.
minimumEvidence.limitation: Exact scalar matches identify recorded sources of the stored minimum within its spatial scope. Multiple equal-speed matches are retained; no single causal frame is invented. A comparison is flagged only for a speed diagnosis with an exact recorded match.

minimumWitness.limitation: Minimum over all expanded-window frames is a spatial observation; the regional accumulator includes only drifting samples or the closing sample of a live run. Exact reported-minimum matches identify the actual sample used.

guidanceSummary.head: d2c8c480ac707b9309ebaebdefd3e41e37176dca
guidanceSummary.method: Descriptive grouping only. Guided and other candidates have different selected parents and targets; acceptance-rate differences do not by themselves estimate causal effectiveness. Repeated failure is not proof of an impossible family.

completedParentReuse.method: Accepted, valid, finished candidates with completed regional metrics; chronological genetic parentId and parentGeneHash must match. No new physics evaluation.
completedParentReuse.limitation: This counts observed reuse, including failed children; it does not prove every specialist remained archived continuously. Checkpoint budgets differ by vehicle and are shown separately. Parameter-only parent assignments are not genetic parent reuse.

repeatedGuidanceFailure.method: Observed repeated failures under unchanged production Engine; no physical replay beyond benchmark yet; hypotheses remain hypotheses.
